metadata.description: The native shell conformance rows (T02, E rows a provider owns): the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, network negatives judged by canaries outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.

The private Linux projection transport rows: builds the unqualified FUSE bridge from explicitly supplied pinned libfuse 3.17.2 headers and library (TAU_PROJECTION_NODE_HEADERS, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_HEADERS, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_LIBRARY, TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_SHA256), checks with objdump -T that neither the bridge nor libfuse needs a glibc newer than D9's oldest Linux target (2.39, Ubuntu 24.04) and that a lower baseline refuses the build, then runs the native transport tests against a real kernel FUSE mount, the host's test-only owner harness that publishes the PP3 spelling families through a held rooted claim (G5), and the unactivated projection owner's inbound convergence, page-cache invalidation, conflict journal and quota. Proves transport, outbound classification and the owner's mechanisms, never D8 activation. Never cached.

commands: if node scripts/build-shell-projection.mts --node-headers "$TAU_PROJECTION_NODE_HEADERS" --fuse-headers "$TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_HEADERS" --fuse-library "$TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_LIBRARY" --fuse-sha256 "$TAU_PROJECTION_FUSE_SHA256" --glibc-baseline 2.2.5; then echo 'ABI negative control: a bridge needing glibc above 2.2.5 was not refused' >&2; exit 1; fi
